sources.snippet: YOLOv10l Finetuned on VisDrone Fine-tuned YOLOv10l object detector for aerial imagery using the VisDrone benchmark dataset. This model is part of the VisDrone Detection Model Zoo, a collection of YOLO models trained and evaluated under a common pipeline for aerial object detection.

sources.title: yolov10/docs/en/datasets/detect/visdrone.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: The VisDrone dataset is widely used for training and evaluating deep learning models in drone-based computer vision tasks such as object detection, object tracking, and crowd counting. The dataset's diverse set of sensor data, object annotations, and attributes make it a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners in the field of drone-based computer vision.
